meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: Data center colocation, hybrid IT infrastructure, cloud and managed services

analysis.summary: TierPoint is the only one refreshing sales pages, while Digital Realty publishes new AI and sovereignty content. The others show little activity, and Rackspace's huge count looks like duplicates.

points.text: TierPoint updated 15 older pages, mostly cloud, security and DR service pages. That is a refresh push aimed at buyers, not a new-content push.
Digital Realty published 14 new pages with no updates. They mix research, case studies and city pages, all tied to AI infrastructure.
Rackspace's 12156 new pages come from two titles repeated: healthcare IT reliability and AI data control. Treat it as two themes, not volume.

TierPoint.play: Refreshes cloud, DR and security service pages. Adds VMware VCF 9, AI and a case study.

Digital Realty.play: Publishes new AI infrastructure content: research, case studies, and city pages for Toronto, Paris, Hong Kong.

Flexential.play: Updated two explainers on business continuity and responsible data center growth. Nothing new.

Rackspace Technology.play: Repeats two themes, healthcare IT reliability and AI data control, across many pages.

CoreSite.play: Light output: one explainer on operations support centers and one colocation benefits refresh.

Expedient.play: One new Nutanix multi-tenant webinar page. Little else this month.

shared.title: Basic explainers
shared.text: Flexential and CoreSite each updated or added simple pages on resilience and colocation value. This is low-volume, early-stage education, not a big push.

gaps.title: Disaster recovery education
gaps.text: TierPoint has a DRaaS sales page. No rival shows learning content on DR. Guides on recovery planning and testing could win early-stage readers.

gaps.title: VMware exit series
gaps.text: Only TierPoint has a VCF 9 explainer. No rival covers it. Add migration guides and cost comparisons while the topic is open.

gaps.title: Healthcare and finance hybrid IT
gaps.text: Rackspace covers healthcare and Digital Realty covers finance, each narrowly. TierPoint could publish industry pages on compliance and uptime for managed hosting.

versus.Digital Realty: Publishes more new learning content (11 learning pages) on AI and sovereignty. TierPoint has more buyer-focused service pages and updates, but fewer new pieces.
versus.Flexential: Far quieter: 2 updated explainers, no new pages. TierPoint is refreshing more pages and aims at buyers, not early learners.
versus.Rackspace Technology: Mostly learning content, repeated across thousands of pages. TierPoint is smaller but more varied, with service pages, a case study and an explainer.
versus.CoreSite: Very low output, all educational. TierPoint has more activity and a stronger focus on buying-stage service pages.
versus.Expedient: One Nutanix webinar page. TierPoint also covers Nutanix with an updated managed private cloud page, plus VMware and public cloud pages.
